answer.sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT GAMES_GAME_ID, HOME_TEAM_ID, HOME_TEAM_WINS
  FROM NBA.TRANSFORMED.src_games
  WHERE SEASON = 2018
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY GAMES_GAME_ID ORDER BY GAMES_GAME_ID) = 1
)
SELECT
  t.TEAM_ID,
  t.TEAM_ABBREVIATION,
  ROUND(SUM(g.HOME_TEAM_WINS) / COUNT(g.GAMES_GAME_ID), 3) AS home_win_rate
FROM g
JOIN NBA.TRANSFORMED.dim_teams_cleansed t
  ON g.HOME_TEAM_ID = t.TEAM_ID
GROUP BY t.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_ABBREVIATION
ORDER BY SUM(g.HOME_TEAM_WINS) / COUNT(g.GAMES_GAME_ID) DESC, t.TEAM_ABBREVIATION
LIMIT 1
